'''Aina Muceniece''' (23 March 1924 – 14 February 2010)<ref name=lza>{{Cite web |url=http://inventions.lza.lv/izg_en.php?id=68 |title=Aina Muceniece |publisher=[[Latvian Academy of Sciences]] |accessdate=20 April 2018 |archive-date=6 April 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090406104313/http://inventions.lza.lv/izg_en.php?id=68 |url-status=dead }}</ref> was a [[Latvian people|Latvian]] [[Immunology|immunologist]] and founder of practical cancer virotherapy <ref name="Pietiek :: Dzīvesziņa">{{Cite web|url=https://pietiek.com/raksti/dziveszina/|title = Pietiek :: Dzīvesziņa}}</ref> who discovered that an [[echovirus]] might be a useful treatment for [[melanoma]].

==Life and work==
Aina Muceniece was born in [[Katlakalns]], [[Latvia]]. Aina Muceniece is from a working-class family. She has said that hard work and life experience in poverty and hunger, have strengthened her for the future cause of life.<ref name="Pietiek :: Dzīvesziņa"/> A. Muceniece belonged to the ancient nation – [[Livonians|Livs]], where the roots go back into the 5,000 years of history and were described as a belligerent and brave nation.<ref name="Pietiek :: Dzīvesziņa"/> She graduated in 1941 from the Vilis Olavs School of Commerce in [[Riga]], a private school of commerce for young women. <ref>{{Cite web |title=Vilis Olavs Riga City School of Commerce |url=https://www.yerusha-search.eu/viewer/metadata/CAH-0673/ |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=-: Vilis Olavs Riga City School of Commerce, -: - -. |language=lv}}</ref> She also worked as a nurse during World War II in [[Yaroslavl]], [[USSR]]. After the war, she studied medicine at the [[Latvian State University]], where she earned a doctor's degree in 1974. Muceniece achieved [[habilitation]] (Dr.habil.med.) in 1992.<ref name=lza_lv/>

Muceniece's scientific career began at the August Kirhenstein Institute of Microbiology, [[Latvian Academy of Sciences]] ({{Langx|lv|LZA Augusta Kirhenšteina Mikrobioloģijas institūts}}), first as a senior laboratory assistant, later as a senior research associate.<ref name=lza_lv/>  Muceniece's laboratory started to study [[enterovirus]]es in the 1960s, and the research led to the identification of an [[echovirus]] that had possible use to treat melanoma, which became [[RIGVIR]].<ref name=sceptical_society>{{Cite web |url=http://skepticisms.lv/enciklopedija/rigvir-when-science-takes-a-back-seat/ |title=When Science Takes A Back Seat |publisher=Skeptiskā biedrība |first=Eduards|last=Ritums |date=October 2016 |accessdate=20 April 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180702150742/http://skepticisms.lv/enciklopedija/rigvir-when-science-takes-a-back-seat/ |archive-date=2 July 2018 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Production and research was discontinued in 1999 and restarted after national registration in Latvia in 2004.<ref name=sceptical_society/>

Muceniece also worked at the [[Pauls Stradiņš Hospital]] and the National Oncology Center as an immunology consultant from 1977 to 2003.<ref name=lza_lv/>

In 2002 she was made an honorary member of the Latvian Association of Oncologists.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.zz.lv/vietejas-zinas/jelgava/muziba-aizgajusi-medicinas-doktore-un-pretveza-medikamenta-rigivir-izgudrotaja-muceniece-20096 |title=Mūžībā aizgājusi medicīnas doktore un pretvēža medikamenta "Rigivir" izgudrotāja Muceniece |publisher=Zemgales Ziņas |author=[[LETA]] |language=Latvian |date=15 February 2010 |accessdate=20 April 2018 |quote=''2002.gadā saņēmusi apbalvojumu kā Latvijas onkologu asociācijas goda locekle'' |archive-date=21 April 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180421031524/http://www.zz.lv/vietejas-zinas/jelgava/muziba-aizgajusi-medicinas-doktore-un-pretveza-medikamenta-rigivir-izgudrotaja-muceniece-20096 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2005 Muceniece received the [[Cross of Recognition]] for meritorious service to the [[Republic of Latvia]].<ref name=dbiz20090627>{{Cite web |url=http://www.db.lv/zinas/latvija-var-medicina-ir-milestiba-204440 |title=Latvija var! Medicīna ir mīlestība |publisher=Dienas Bizness |first=Jana |last=Gavare |language=Latvian |date=27 June 2009 |accessdate=20 April 2018 |quote=''Apbalvojumi: LR Atzinības krusts par sevišķiem nopelniem Latvijas valsts labā (2005)'' |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180421031004/http://www.db.lv/zinas/latvija-var-medicina-ir-milestiba-204440 |archive-date=21 April 2018 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Before she died in 2010, she published 190 papers and three [[monograph]]s.<ref name=lza_lv>{{Cite web |url=http://inventions.lza.lv/izg.php?id=65 |title=Aina Muceniece |publisher=[[Latvian Academy of Sciences]] |language=Latvian |accessdate=20 April 2018 |archive-date=28 April 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180428013528/http://inventions.lza.lv/izg.php?id=65 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Remembrance and criticism of RIGVIR ==
On February 14, 2016, the Professor Aina Muceniece Virotherapy Foundation was established, which helps people around the world to receive virotherapy, as well as continues the special compensation system created by Professor Muceniece's family, ensuring the availability of RIGVIR to Latvians with significant discounts.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Par mums|url=http://www.virotherapyfoundation.org/lv/par-mums/|access-date=2021-11-19|website=Virotherapy Foundation|language=lv}}</ref>

In 2017, the organizations of Latvian professional doctors, including the Latvian Association of Oncologists, request to remove the preparation “RIGVIR” from the list of reimbursable medicinal products and cancel the registration of the preparation in the State Register of Medicinal Products. The justification was that the studies and publications on which RIGVIR is based are of poor quality.<ref name="lsm.lv">{{Cite web|title="Rigvir" neiztur arī papildu pārbaudes; liedz tirgot Latvijā|url=https://www.lsm.lv/raksts/zinas/latvija/rigvir-neiztur-ari-papildu-parbaudes-liedz-tirgot-latvija.a314362/|access-date=2021-11-19|website=www.lsm.lv|language=lv}}</ref>

In March 2019, after repeated testing of the preparation “RIGVIR”, a discrepancy was found between the content specified by the manufacturer and the content of the samples submitted for analysis. Therefore, a decision has been made to ban the marketing of RIGVIR in Latvia and to remove it from the list of reimbursable medicines.<ref name="lsm.lv"/>
